mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_onboarding (tenant_id, workspace_id, owner_user_id, template_key, template_version, template_sha256, stage, paused, config_version, steps_total, steps_estimated, current_step_index, request_key, draft_json, version, creator_id, modifier_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workspaceId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{templateKey}, #{templateVersion}, #{templateSha256}, #{stage}, #{paused}, #{configVersion}, #{stepsTotal}, #{stepsEstimated}, #{currentStepIndex}, #{requestKey}, #{draftJson}, 0, #{creatorId}, #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace_onboarding WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_onboarding SET template_key = #{templateKey}, template_version = #{templateVersion}, template_sha256 = #{templateSha256}, stage = #{stage}, paused = #{paused}, config_version = #{configVersion}, steps_total = #{stepsTotal}, steps_estimated = #{stepsEstimated}, current_step_index = #{currentStepIndex}, draft_json = #{draftJson}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_onboarding_step (tenant_id, onboarding_id, step_key, name, kind, step_order, status, reason, evidence, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{onboardingId}, #{stepKey}, #{name}, #{kind}, #{stepOrder}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{evidence}, 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_onboarding_step WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND onboarding_id = #{onboardingId} AND step_key = #{stepKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO harness_snapshot (tenant_id, workspace_id, onboarding_id, snapshot_type, onboarding_version, template_key, template_version, template_sha256, content_json, content_sha256, expires_at, creator_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workspaceId}, #{onboardingId}, #{snapshotType}, #{onboardingVersion}, #{templateKey}, #{templateVersion}, #{templateSha256}, #{contentJson}, #{contentSha256}, #{expiresAt}, #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM harness_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO harness_run (tenant_id, workspace_id, onboarding_id, snapshot_id, run_type, status, result_json, failure_json, version, creator_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workspaceId}, #{onboardingId}, #{snapshotId}, #{runType}, #{status}, #{resultJson}, #{failureJson}, 0, #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM harness_run WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM harness_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO harness_run_step (tenant_id, run_id, step_no, object_key, object_type, status, object_id, error_message) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{stepNo}, #{objectKey}, #{objectType}, #{status}, #{objectId}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM harness_run_step WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND object_key = #{objectKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM harness_run_step WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_readiness_check (tenant_id, workspace_id, onboarding_id, config_version, status, evidence_json, checked_at, creator_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workspaceId}, #{onboardingId}, #{configVersion}, #{status}, #{evidenceJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{creatorId})
